limits: Build, fixture and executable call-graph evidence only; no game execution or binary-ABI compatibility claim.

The buffered view preserves read_all's captured-length and short-read policy, including stopping at that extent. It does not convert arbitrary native EOF or error behavior into success.
The new path retains a temporary string while creating the returned byte vector; its byte-at-a-time append work has not been profiled in gameplay.
